_info: Source de traduction de Better Weaponry. Les noms d'armes sont construits avec 'pattern' : {type} et {material} sont remplacés par les noms ci-dessous ({type|lower} = première lettre en minuscule). Un matériau peut avoir une forme par genre (clé = 'gender' du type) et son propre 'pattern'. 'overrides' force le nom d'un objet précis. Après modification : gradlew runData.

strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.format_vers: Version of the file format. Leave it at 1.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.attack_spee: Attacks per second at full strength (vanilla sword: 1.6). Above 2, part of the hits on a single target are lost to its invulnerability time.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.attack_reac: How far away you can hit entities, in blocks (vanilla: 3).
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.base_damage: Damage of the wooden version, as shown on the tooltip. Each material multiplies it by its own factor (stone ×1.25, iron ×1.5, diamond ×1.75, netherite ×2, gold ×1) and rounds it to the nearest half point.
strings.better_weaponry.field.weapon.material_da: Forces the damage of some materials, for example { "golden": 6 }. Materials that are not listed use base_damage × their factor.
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.title: Better Weaponry: weapon settings
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.intro: This folder changes the stats of the Better Weaponry weapons for all your worlds. Your files only contain what you change: everything else keeps the mod's default values, even after an update.
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.folders:
What is in this folder:
  weapons/          one file per weapon type: add the fields you want to change.
  rules.json        global rules (dual wielding...).
  defaults/         the mod's default values, rewritten at every launch. Read them and copy fields from them, but do not edit them.
  *.schema.json     used by code editors such as VS Code: autocompletion, help when hovering a field, errors underlined.
  README.txt        this file, rewritten at every launch in the game's language.
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.errors: If a value is invalid (wrong type, out of range), it is ignored and the previous value is kept. Errors are shown in the chat to operators and to the host of a single-player game, and written to logs/latest.log. Comments starting with // are allowed, and so are keys starting with _ (for example "_note").
strings.better_weaponry.doc.readme.weapon_fields: Fields of a weapon file (all optional):
strings.better_weaponry.command.no_permission: Only operators can open the editor. Use /betterweaponry codex to read the weapon stats.
strings.better_weaponry.command.dps.header: DPS at full charge (vanilla iron sword: %s):
strings.better_weaponry.data.problem.item_confli: %1$s › items: %2$s is already used by %3$s (ignored here)
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.format_versio: Version of the file format. Leave it at 1.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.replace_vanil: Replace vanilla gear in loot and trades
true: loot and villagers give the mod's versions instead of the vanilla item.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.loot_upgrade_: In loot, starting from wood, chance in % of moving up to the next material (gold, stone, iron, diamond, netherite). Rolled again at each step.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.enchanted_boo: Chance in % for a chest of the Nether or the End to hold a book with one of the mod's enchantments.
strings.enchantment.better_weaponry.reflective.d: A perfect parry sends 10/20/30% of a melee attack back at the attacker, along with its effects, then the item goes on cooldown. Goes on shields and on anything that can parry. Incompatible with Riposte.
strings.enchantment.better_weaponry.vampirism.de: Heals you for part of the melee damage you deal. The healing grows more and more slowly on big hits. Incompatible with Bleeding.
strings.enchantment.better_weaponry.riposte.desc: After a perfect parry, your next hit deals 25/50/75% more damage, on top of the usual bonus. Incompatible with Reflective.
strings.enchantment.better_weaponry.execution.de: Deals 10/20/30% more damage to targets below 30% of their health.
strings.enchantment.better_weaponry.bleeding.des: Fully charged hits make the target bleed for 2/3/4 seconds. Sickles, scythes and katanas only. Skeletons are immune. Incompatible with Fire Aspect and Vampirism.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.projectile_sp: Multiplier of the projectile speed of bows and crossbows, by material id, e.g. {"iron": 1.2}. Arrow damage depends on this speed: 1 is the vanilla bow, the stone one. Materials not listed use their damage multiplier minus 0.34.
Highest speed multiplier, whatever the material. Arrow damage depends on speed: this keeps very strong modded materials under control.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.golden_draw_t: Draw or load time of golden bows and crossbows compared to vanilla. 0.5: twice as fast.
strings.enchantment.better_weaponry.returning.de: Shurikens that land fly back to you like a Loyalty trident and give their durability back. Incompatible with Mending.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.shurikens.hel: Settings of the shurikens. Each throw uses 1 durability, picking the shuriken up gives it back. The material changes the speed, like for bows.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.shurikens.thr: Speed of a stone shuriken. A fully drawn arrow flies at 3. Damage depends on speed.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.shurikens.bas: Multiplied by the speed on impact, then rounded up. An arrow has 2.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.shurikens.coo: Time before you can throw this shuriken again, in seconds.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.help: Weapons and behavior of mobs. No more mobs are armed than in vanilla: only a mob that would get a vanilla weapon or tool can get a weapon of the mod instead.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.upgrade_: Chance in % of moving up to the next material, rolled again at each step and 1.5 times higher on Hard. Limited to iron in the Overworld, diamond in the Nether and the End, one step more on Hard (not in the End).
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.modded_w: Chance in % that a vanilla weapon or tool held by a hostile mob becomes a weapon of the mod. 0: mobs keep their vanilla weapons.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.dual_wie: Among mobs that get a weapon of the mod, chance in % of having one in each hand. The off-hand weapon is never dropped.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.ninja_sk: Chance in % that a skeleton throws shurikens instead of shooting a bow.
strings.better_weaponry.field.gear.mobs.captain_: true: patrol and raid captains carry a shield of the mod in their off hand. It is never dropped.
strings.better_weaponry.info.ranged: Only the projectile speed depends on the material: arrow damage follows it. Gold loads twice as fast but shoots slower.
strings.better_weaponry.info.shuriken: Right click to throw. Each throw costs 1 durability; picking the shuriken back up returns it. Throwing the last point destroys the item, and picking that shuriken up brings it back.
strings.better_weaponry.notice.combat_reforged: The combat system of Better Weaponry (combos, parries, dashes, tutorials and the editor) is now the separate mod Combat Reforged. Install it to get them back. You can turn this message off in config/better_weaponry/compat.json.
strings.better_weaponry.field.compat.reach_enabl: Each weapon uses its own attack reach. It also turns off when a mod of the list below is loaded.
strings.better_weaponry.field.compat.balance_abi: With Combat Reforged, weapons with abilities deal slightly less damage.
strings.better_weaponry.field.compat.reach_disab: If one of these mods is loaded, weapons no longer apply their own reach.
strings.better_weaponry.field.compat.combat_refo: Tells players once where the combat system went.
